name: image-proxy
summary: A Next.js route that proxies remote podcast artwork from your own origin, with an SSRF guard that rejects private-network and non-HTTPS targets.

rename.why: Identifies your traffic to every image host as Podtards.
X-Image-Proxy response header naming a host that no longer resolves. Replace with your host or delete the header.

caveats: Do not relax the HTTPS-only check in proxy-guard.ts to support HTTP artwork; it blocks a class of redirect-to-internal-host attack.
No caching layer. Put a CDN or Cache-Control in front before serving real traffic.
